title: Public website foundation and launch surface
objective: Establish Deskal's first canonical public website foundation with the current Deskal product identity, local-first authority messaging, bounded security claims, responsive production-grade Next.js UI, reusable brand assets, and independent web CI qualification without changing runtime authority or compatibility identifiers.

include: a new isolated apps/web Next.js application with responsive public marketing surfaces
Deskal monochrome and full-color brand mark assets and current product copy
public explanations of local-first authority, approvals, security boundaries, and MCP compatibility
web typecheck, test, and production-build CI qualification
visual QA on desktop and mobile viewports
exclude: changes to qdral compatibility CLI, daemon, npm packages, environment variables, OAuth scopes, source paths, storage paths, or MCP server name
changes to local runtime authority, MCP tool exposure, provider execution, approvals, trust, leases, policy, audit, or revocation
hosted backend services, analytics, tracking, cookies, authentication, payments, or mandatory paid infrastructure
release artifact replacement or installer changes

authority_delta.filesystem: None. Static repository website source and generated build output only.
authority_delta.network: None at Deskal runtime. The website contains ordinary outbound documentation/source links only.
authority_delta.secrets: None. No secret-bearing environment variables or telemetry.

invariants: Deskal is the only current product brand on the public website
qdral appears only where required by the compatibility contract
marketing copy must not claim authority or capability beyond canonical evidence
the website must not add telemetry, tracking, hosted control, or mandatory cloud dependence
web dependencies are pinned and qualified independently from runtime packages
runtime and MCP authority remain byte-for-byte outside this grain's intended change surface

acceptance.claim: The responsive website presents Deskal identity, product purpose, security boundaries, and developer MCP connection information without stale Cotra/Quntal branding or misleading Qdral product branding.
The website builds as an optimized production Next.js application, passes strict TypeScript and web tests, and has no required secret, telemetry, analytics, or paid-service dependency.
Brand assets provide monochrome and full-color Deskal mark variants with accessible text treatment and desktop/mobile visual QA.
Repository CI includes independent web typecheck, tests, and production build while all existing Rust, Node, governance, supply-chain, and release qualification gates remain unchanged.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of exclusions, and zero unresolved blocking review threads pass before merge.

successor_requirements.hosting: Production hosting, DNS, analytics, forms, downloads, or backend services require a separately authorized successor if they add external state, credentials, or operational authority.
successor_requirements.launch: Any public release/download CTA must point only to an existing verified Deskal repository or release surface unless a later grain qualifies a new distribution path.

done_when: The public website foundation is merged, exact-head qualified, visually reviewed on desktop and mobile, post-merge CI is green, and canonical evidence records zero runtime authority change.
